referenceFunction.generalComment: Estimation based on data of the power plant in Leibstadt with a net installed capacity of 1080 MW (year 1999). Before construction of the plant, the terrain had to be levelized, which required huge digging, a factor of ten compared to the average for a 1000 MW unit; UUID: a2c847e0-6e3d-3b4e-a14c-7bbc0b25c3e3
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module includes materials, energy and transport requirements used for construction of the plant. Land-use is included with the assumption of 40 years operation. Disposal of non-contaminated material from dismantling is also included, whereas contaminated materials are attributed to the operation.

geography.text: Swiss data of one specific plant.

technology.text: The described plant Leibstadt started commercial operation at the end of 1984. It belongs to the 1000 MW class (net installed capacity has been upgraded in steps from the original 990 MW to 1165 MW at the end of 1999). It has a GE designed primary circuit, a Mark III containment, and a cooling tower. This module can be assumed to be representative for other boiling water reactors of the same class in Western Europe.
